question:
The following pie chart represents the break-up of Piyush's monthly expenses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fb2e35c8fe42ec65a99a4b40ec420554256670499080b9b96d91ce22a346c6f.png] 

If Piyush spent Rs. 3,780 more on education than he spent on housing, then find his monthly expenses (in Rs.).
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question,

30% - 20% = 3780

⇒ 10% = 3780

⇒ 100% = 37,800

**∴ His monthly expenses (in Rs.) is 37,800.**
